vault_tokens.source: estimated: chars / 4 (the API does not expose Groq usage); input includes the level system prompt; hidden reasoning tokens of gpt-oss are not visible, so output is a lower bound

guard_cpu_seconds.source: upper bound: server-side latency_ms of guard-blocked requests (guard call + DB, no vault); the API does not expose the guard's own latency_ms. Every L4 request calls the input guard once.

actual_bill_note: Groq free tier, Vercel Hobby (guard + API), Neon free; $0 budget (ADR-0037)

vault_groq_gpt_oss_20b.note: groq.com/pricing renders client-side and showed no prices to a plain fetch; the provider's official models page lists 'PRICE PER 1M TOKENS' for openai/gpt-oss-20b
vault_groq_gpt_oss_20b.caveat: tokens are chars/4 estimates and exclude hidden reasoning tokens, so this is a lower bound; fallback models (used only if Groq rate-limits) price differently
